name: top_customer_complaints_and_fix_priorities
description: Reads customer_feedback.csv, labels themes, ranks complaint themes with traceable row references and quoted examples, and words a concrete fix-first recommendation.

manifest.name: top_customer_complaints_and_fix_priorities
manifest.description: Reads customer_feedback.csv, labels themes, ranks complaint themes with traceable row references and quoted examples, and words a concrete fix-first recommendation.
manifest.example_input: {"folder":"novak_trading","top_n":5,"question":"What are our top customer complaints and what should we fix first?"}
manifest.purpose:
a bot that reads our customer feedback and lists the top complaints and what we should fix first

Files: folder novak_trading
manifest.headline: Top {top_n} complaints in {input.folder}: {ranking.0.category} ({ranking.0.percentage}% of cases). Fix first: {fix_first}
examples: What are the top 5 customer complaints in our feedback?
Show me the biggest issues customers are reporting and what we should prioritize
Analyze complaints from last month and tell me what needs fixing urgently
manifest.manual_basis: Reading through feedback records, categorizing complaints, counting occurrences, calculating percentages, identifying root causes, and prioritizing fixes by impact.
